version: Year 37 EF / s882 (Tekna + trading words added)
note: 353-word working lexicon from the record (Appendix V-14) with the record fix map = mapa; codes are 4 digits: first digit = class

classes.0: control: grammar markers 0001-0015, bot job tags 0101-0105, Tekna (machine, AI, robot words) 0201-0299, frame 0090-0099

entries.english: NUMBER LITERAL: the next token is a number written in digits
NAME: the next token is a code from the 9000 name registry
NEW WORD: the next token is spelled out, not yet in the lexicon
JOB 1 - COMMAND: the bot obeys it
JOB 2 - CHECK: the bot tests it before acting
JOB 3 - VALUE: a level, size, speed or time
JOB 4 - TALK: kept on the receipt, never obeyed
JOB 5 - LOCKED: refused, a bot can never order it
agent; a bot sent to act for someone
owner; the human a bot answers to (tena have + -or)
log; record of what a bot did
receipt; signed proof of an action
command; an order a bot may obey
fourth; a quarter (un karta = one quarter)
win; a trade that ended up
size; how big a trade is
open trade; a position still running
